Levi_1: third-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:34), son of Leah
Judah_1: fourth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:35), son of Leah
Benjamin_1: twelfth-born son of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 35:18)
Korah_3: son of Izhar (Exodus 6:21) who rebelled against God and Moses (Numbers chapter 16)
Phinehas_1: Eleazar's son, Aaron's grandson (Exodus 6:25) given a covenant of peace and perpetual priesthood (Numbers 25:13)
Samuel_1: the leader of the tribe of Simeon (Numbers 34:20) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Kish_1: a mighty man of valor [perhaps wealth or influence] (1 Samuel 9:1)
Saul_1: son of Kish (1 Samuel 9:2), King of Israel (1 Samuel 11:15)
Ahitub_3: son of Amariah (1 Chronicles 6:11), Levite (1 Chronicles 6:1), father of Meraioth (1 Chronicles 9:11)
Zadok_3: (grand)son of Ahitub and father of Shallum (1 Chronicles 6:12)
Shallum_6: son of Zadok (1 Chronicles 6:12) and father of Hilkiah (1 Chronicles 6:13), Levite (1 Chronicles 6:1)
Hilkiah_3: son of Shallum and father of Azariah (1 Chronicles 6:13), stood on Ezra's right hand as he read from the Law (Nehemiah 8:4)
Azariah_7: son of Hilkiah (1 Chronicles 6:13), father of Seriah (1 Chronicles 6:14), and priest (Ezra 2:2, Nehemiah 7:7, Nehemiah 12:1), explained the law to the people (Nehemiah 8:7)
Hashabiah_1: son of Amaziah (1 Chronicles 6:45), Levite during the return (Nehemiah 10:11, Nehemiah 12:24)
Abdon_3: son of Jeiel and Maacah (1 Chronicles 8:30), firstborn (1 Chronicles 9:35)
Zur_3: son of Jeiel and Maacah (1 Chronicles 8:30)
Kish_2: son of Jeiel and Maacah (1 Chronicles 8:30)
Baal_2: son of Jeiel and Maacah (1 Chronicles 8:30)
Nadab_4: son of Jeiel and Maacah (1 Chronicles 8:30)
Gedor_3: son of Jeiel and Maacah (1 Chronicles 8:31)
Ahio_3: son of Jeiel and Maacah (1 Chronicles 8:31)
Zecher_1: son of Jeiel and Maacah (1 Chronicles 8:31)
Mikloth_1: son of Jeiel and Maacah (1 Chronicles 8:32)
Bani_3: descendant of Perez (1 Chronicles 9:4) and leader during the return (Nehemiah 10:14)
Jedaiah_2: priest (1 Chronicles 9:10, Nehemiah 7:39, Nehemiah 12:6), of the house of Jeshua (Ezra 2:36)
Pashhur_1: son of Malchijah (1 Chronicles 9:12), priest (Ezra 2:38, Nehemiah 7:41)
Malchijah_2: father of Pashhur (1 Chronicles 9:12), stood on Ezra's left hand as he read from the Law (Nehemiah 8:4)
Immer_1: father of Meshillemith (1 Chronicles 9:12), priest (Ezra 2:37, Nehemiah 7:40)
Bakbakkar_1: counted among the Levites carried into exile (1 Chronicles 9:15)
Heresh_1: counted among the Levites carried into exile (1 Chronicles 9:15)
Galal_1: counted among the Levites carried into exile (1 Chronicles 9:15)- son of Jeduthun (1 Chronicles 9:16)
Asaph_3: father of Zichri (1 Chronicles 9:15), singer (Ezra 2:41, Nehemiah 7:44)
Elkanah_6: lived in the villages of the Netophathites (1 Chronicles 9:16)
Shallum_7: one of the gatekeepers (1 Chronicles 9:17), to the east (1 Chronicles 26:14), gatekeeper (Ezra 2:42, Nehemiah 7:45, Nehemiah 12:25)
Akkub_2: one of the gatekeepers (1 Chronicles 9:17, Ezra 2:42, Nehemiah 7:45, Nehemiah 12:25)
Talmon_1: one of the gatekeepers (1 Chronicles 9:17, Ezra 2:42, Nehemiah 7:45, Nehemiah 12:25)
Kore_1: father of Shallum, descendant of Korah (1 Chronicles 9:19)
Zechariah_4: son of Meshelemiah [Shallum] (1 Chronicles 9:21), gatekeeper (1 Chronicles 26:14)
Jeiel_2: the father of [the city of ] Gibeon (1 Chronicles 9:35)
